name: LLM Wiki — Canvas LMS
context: Save Canvas LMS pages (lectures, assignments, discussions, announcements, syllabi) into the LLM Wiki's raw/ directory. The clip drops into raw/<course-id>/ — relocate manually into a subject-matter topic directory (e.g., raw/cryptography/) during the next /wiki:sync.
_notes_for_first_install: This template is a best-effort author. Obsidian Web Clipper's full template JSON schema is not publicly documented as of this writing. When you import this into the Web Clipper extension, verify: (1) the URL trigger pattern fires on your Canvas instance, (2) the path resolves to raw/<some-topic>/ as expected (it uses the Canvas course ID as a fallback topic — you'll relocate clips during /wiki:sync), (3) frontmatter property names match the framework's required schema (title, collected, published, topics, content_type, source_url), (4) the body selectors capture the page content and drop Canvas's nav chrome. Field syntax (e.g., {{url|split:'/'|index:5}}) may need adjustment for your Web Clipper version. Once validated, replace this comment with usage notes for your team.
